faq.q: What is an AI product background changer?
faq.a: It is a tool that keeps your product and replaces the setting behind it. You start from one existing photo and get a finished square photo with the new background in place.

faq.q: How do I change a product background?
faq.a: Upload one product photo, name the surface, color or room you want, and generate. Then review the edges and download the new image.

faq.q: Will my product change when the background changes?
faq.a: The item should stay the same: same angle, same scale, same edges. Small printed details can shift, so compare each result with the real product before you publish.

faq.q: Do I get a transparent cut-out?
faq.a: No. You get a complete photo with the new setting already in place, ready to upload. For a plain white version, use the white background photo tool.
Simple surfaces and colors keep attention on the item: marble, light wood, stone, linen or a solid brand color. Busy patterns can compete with the product.

faq.q: Can the new photo run in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and are licensed for commercial use. Keep the product identical to what you sell, and add any price or offer in your ad tool.

faq.q: Can I pick a seasonal or outdoor setting?
faq.a: Yes. Name one room, surface or outdoor scene, such as a holiday shelf or a garden table. One clear setting works best.

faq.q: How is this different from a reshoot?
faq.a: A reshoot means booking space and setting up lights again. Here the new setting is generated from your existing photo in minutes, at far less cost.
